bookend_note: Splice canonical: canon6-short (short hair, canon6-short/C.npy, window 80-91, anchor 86) for all dance clips. Construction history: dissolve splice (canon5 era, then canon6 from wave 38) superseded at wave 54 by the HARD-CUT construction (user ruling 2026-11-26: [C86 C87 pure] + full body + [C85 C86 pure], no dissolves; first frame = last frame = C86; body frames keep their legacy timeline indices). The dissolve versions are archived in pack2/superseded/*-pre54-dissolve-superseded.*. Specials (idle/invite/clap/combo) carry no bookend splice and are unchanged at wave 54. Wave 55 (2026-11-27, user prescriptions 「将后面正常的头部移到前3帧，身体别动」 + 「连接处太长」): (1) STATIC TRIM first — body head/tail static runs (figure-region frame-diff < 25% of the clip's median body diff) trimmed to at most 1 stance frame before motion onset and at most 2 after motion end, moving frames never trimmed; accents shifted by -(head_trim/24)s, ZERO accents dropped on all 20 clips; frame counts 244 -> 205..244 (slow-02 220 -> 217), per-clip calibration in each entry's static_trim record. (2) HEAD TRANSPLANT on the trimmed files — the canon head on the four bookend frames (0, 1, N-2, N-1) is replaced by the clip's own first body frame's head (feathered mask, blend boundary at the neck/collar line, extended per column to the lower of the two heads' hair-strand bottoms; frames 0 and N-1 share one alpha so first=last identity is preserved). Measured on the final files: bookend->body hair step at clip start +11.8..+20.0% (fast-14 -17.9%) before, -1.6..+2.0% after on all 20; pixels below the mask bit-identical pre-encode; first=last max 34-48 / mean 0.32-0.41 (encode-noise class). Tail steps (body-end -> tail bookend) after: 17 clips >10% (fast-08 +40.3% highest; fast-09 +8.8%, slow-01 +8.0%, fast-14 +2.1% under), flagged per clip in head_transplant records. (3) CHAIN GATE (fast-01->02->03, keyed over the dark stage backdrop, static = the same 25%-of-median definition): perceptual static zone per join 4 frames (v1.0.82 files) -> 2 frames (new), target <=8. Pre-trim files archived in pack2/superseded/*-pre55-hardcut-superseded.*.
